overview_blocks.label: Big idea
overview_blocks.body: “Skech Your Vibe”: creative freedom can be found anywhere, from city alleys to the beach to street music. Tagline: “Skech in style, feel the vibe.”

overview_blocks.label: Story
overview_blocks.body: One character’s journey in four parts: alley, beach, busking band and night city. His T-shirt artwork turns into 2D animation at each stop.

overview_blocks.label: Look and cast
overview_blocks.body: Stylised cinematic realism, with a live-action look mixed with animated 2D Cloakwork artwork. 8 characters: 6 male, 2 female.

overview_blocks.label: Timeline
overview_blocks.body: Planned: storyboard 10 Jun to final approval 23 Jun 2026. Client review rounds continued to 10 Jul 2026.

overview_blocks.label: Audience
overview_blocks.body: Young generation: rural mass on the East Coast, and urban households in the Klang Valley.

overview_blocks.label: Big idea
overview_blocks.body: Superhero-film energy with human-like characters in forward-futuristic fashion, shown training their abilities. Pillars: Fashion, Action, Attitude.

overview_blocks.label: Look and cast
overview_blocks.body: Stylised reality: realistic characters in a bright orange-sky metropolis, never dark or dystopian.

overview_blocks.label: Timeline
overview_blocks.body: Brief 25 Mar 2026, target final approval 10 Apr, live date 13 Apr. Final language and format submissions ran to 13 May 2026.

overview_blocks.label: Big idea
overview_blocks.body: “Because family comes first, we made priority shareable.” It places UMobile ULTRA alongside other premium choices, like flying business class.

overview_blocks.label: Cast
overview_blocks.body: A mother in her late 20s and her 2-year-old son, with a pan-Asian look that represents both Malay and Chinese audiences in Malaysia.

overview_blocks.label: Versions
overview_blocks.body: West Coast: the approved key visual. East Coast: the mother wears a modern tudung or hijab look that appeals to the T20 income audience.

overview_blocks.label: Timeline and usage
overview_blocks.body: Hi-res key visual due 12 Mar 2026; launch 7 Apr 2026. Usage in Malaysia for 1 year across BTL, digital, website, social media and on-ground.

overview_blocks.label: Big idea
overview_blocks.body: “From Buffer to Bliss”: the lag and low-fi sound of a bad connection flips into crisp, instant, high-speed sound. Line: “Why settle for a life on buffer?”

overview_blocks.label: Music
overview_blocks.body: Two track ideas: re-engineer the Ultra superhero track, or flip U Mobile’s own jingle. Both move from a slow, muted start to a high-energy payoff.

overview_blocks.label: Timeline
overview_blocks.body: Feedback on 25 May, 8 Jun and 12 Jun 2026, ending with a final English track and a final BM track.

overview_blocks.label: Big idea
overview_blocks.body: “Your Screen. Your World.” The phone screen is a portal: press play and you enter the action as the hero. Ultra Prepaid gives you passage, not just data.

overview_blocks.label: Story
overview_blocks.body: Each film pulls the viewer from a phone screen into a hero moment in first person, then out to a third-person view and the product end frame.

overview_blocks.label: Six moments
overview_blocks.body: Football, motorsport, esports gaming, DJ music, a birthday video call with family, and a K-drama scene, matched to what each community enjoys.

overview_blocks.label: Timeline
overview_blocks.body: Storyboard rounds 22 to 29 Jul, video rounds 4 to 26 Aug 2026, then final videos for Indonesia, Nepal and Bangladesh.

overview_blocks.label: Big idea
overview_blocks.body: “When Life Gives You Twists”: vertical dramas inspired by Chinese and Korean TikTok dramas. Melodramatic, humorous and fast-paced.

overview_blocks.label: Series
overview_blocks.body: 4 episodes, one scam each: fake job offer, lucky draw prize, investment and love scam. Key message: scams prey on emotions, so pause.

overview_blocks.label: Second concept
overview_blocks.body: Also pitched: “Shadow Lines”, a Black Mirror-inspired suspense series built around everyday phone screens and SMS threads.

overview_blocks.label: Timeline
overview_blocks.body: Review rounds from 28 Aug to 14 Sep 2026, then the vertical version adapted on 28 Sep 2026. Episode 1 approved.

overview_blocks.label: Astro touchpoints
overview_blocks.body: Stadium Astro, Syok podcast, Sooka, KULT Offside, Awani and AstroGO’s Ikatan Terlarang appear naturally through his day.

overview_blocks.label: Story arc
overview_blocks.body: A full circle: the day starts and ends in bed on his phone, and a watch timelapse from Casio to Rolex shows career growth with Astro.

overview_blocks.label: Look and sound
overview_blocks.body: Wes Anderson-style cinematography and colour palettes, with ASMR sound cues such as clock flips, a running shower and train doors.

overview_blocks.label: Brand placement
overview_blocks.body: Brands placed inside scenes, including a U Mobile billboard seen from the train and Mamee cup noodles at lunch.

overview_blocks.label: Big idea
overview_blocks.body: “Bah! Scan DuitNow QR”, with the hero message “Caj 0%, Pilih 1 Bulan”. Localised for Borneo, with bold type and high-contrast orange.

overview_blocks.label: Story
overview_blocks.body: Three everyday shoppers scanning at the counter: groceries, Sabah handicraft fashion, and gadgets with friends.

overview_blocks.label: Timeline
overview_blocks.body: Storyboard approved at round 12, static OOH approved 17 Apr and DOOH approved 24 Apr 2026.

overview_blocks.label: Big idea
overview_blocks.body: “More Value in Every Way.” One masterline across three product truths: more rewards (QR Pay), more flexibility (SPayLater), more potential returns (Money+).

overview_blocks.label: Two directions
overview_blocks.body: Say “More” Boldly: big type with lifestyle photography. The Infinite “More”: a flowing wave-style headline with warm everyday moments.

overview_blocks.label: Tonality
overview_blocks.body: Everyday: real people and everyday experiences at the centre of the brand. Confident: bold, declarative sans-serif headlines. Brand first: polished but friendly, less like a typical e-wallet ad.

overview_blocks.label: Status
overview_blocks.body: Draft for discussion, Nov 2026. Direction 1 reached its 7th revision round.

overview_blocks.label: Big idea
overview_blocks.body: “Before We Meet, Scents Do”: a playful romance where a couple separated by a wall meet when their scent trails break through.

overview_blocks.label: Cast and setting
overview_blocks.body: A Kadazan-Dusun man for Kaamatan and an Iban woman for Gawai, in traditional attire, against harvest fields and longhouses.

overview_blocks.label: Language
overview_blocks.body: Malay copy, with Iban for Sarawak and Dusun for Sabah on the end frame, plus an AI-content disclaimer in Malay.

overview_blocks.label: Timeline
overview_blocks.body: Storyboard rounds 8 to 11 May, DOOH review 13 May, final approval 21 to 22 May, live 25 May 2026.
